jobs.description:
Are you an experienced asphalt worker who enjoys rolling up your sleeves?

To strengthen our team, we are looking for an experienced asphalt worker to join our asphalt crew.

What does your job involve?

  • You assist the asphalt crew with the preparation, laying and finishing of hot-mix asphalt;
  • You help ensure the correct distribution and finishing of the asphalt;
  • You are responsible for touching up and finishing asphalt around joints and connections;
  • You help create a smooth and high-quality road surface;
  • You work closely with machine operators, roller operators, drivers and other colleagues on site;
  • You work with modern machinery, techniques and tools;
  • You depart daily from Oostende.
What do we expect from you?

  • You have experience in asphalt works, preferably as an asphalt worker;
  • You have knowledge of the different steps involved in laying and finishing hot-mix asphalt;
  • You are physically fit and enjoy active, hands-on work;
  • You are flexible and have no problem working in different weather conditions;
  • You speak fluent Dutch or English;
  • You are able to get to our depot in Oostende independently every day.

For the strengthening of our team, we are looking for a truck driver with a Category C driving licence to operate our emulsion truck.

You will depart from our depot in Oostende and drive to various construction sites throughout West Flanders. In addition to the transport, you will also be responsible for the correct application and processing of the emulsion on site, meaning you will be active both behind the wheel and on the construction site.

Your responsibilities:

  • You transport emulsion from our depot in Oostende to various construction sites throughout West Flanders;
  • You are responsible for the correct and safe loading and unloading of emulsion;
  • You operate the emulsion truck's equipment and ensure the correct application of the emulsion;
  • You work both with machinery and manually during the processing of emulsion on site.



What do we expect from you?

  • You have a valid Category C driving licence.
  • Code 95 is NOT required.
  • You have good technical insight and are willing to learn how the emulsion truck operates and how emulsion is processed on site.
  • You speak and understand sufficient Dutch or English to communicate safely and smoothly with your colleagues.

Would you like to help build high-quality roads throughout West Flanders? Then we would love to hear from you!

Are you a technical talent with a passion for innovation? Join a high-tech company at the forefront of the automotive semiconductor industry and help shape the technology of tomorrow.
 

YOUR FUTURE JOB As Technical Lead in the night shift, you will be the team lead of all technical profiles (8 people) in this shift in order to maximize production output while ensuring compliance with defined quality standards. You will coordinate and coach all technical profiles and manages the escalations.
 

More specifically, you will:
 

 
• Ensure that equipment performance meets targets and minimize manufacturing failures.
 
• Support in technical issues on the shop-floor and managing the escalation flow.
 
• Develop and coach technical personnel to reach higher team results.
 
• Be responsible for the administration of the personnel in the shift - holidays, sick leaves, transportation, competency review, etc.
 
• Lead and coordinate escalations with other departments to resolve technical issues promptly.
 
• Distribute the technical tasks among technical personnel in the shift, setting up team priorities, and making follow-ups on the progress during the shift.
 
• Participate in improvement projects.
 
• Support the recruitment of technical personnel if needed.
 
• Support / lead the local certification process (depending if there is a training department on site or not).

 
• Relevant Bachelor degree or Technician with around 5 years of relevant experience.
 
• Good knowledge of technical coaching principles.
 
• Excellent communication, team collaboration and targeted mentoring skills.
 
• Good knowledge of MS office/Google.
 
• Good understanding of English.
 
• Ability to use all necessary job-related tools and make precise manual adjustments.
 
• Analytical, logical, and interpretive mindset for complex technical data.
 
• Proven ability to lead and coordinate technical activities on a shift or zone level.

Antwerp Convention Bureau (ACB – www.antwerpconventionbureau.be) focuses on promoting the city of Antwerp as a premium destination for meetings, incentives, conferences, exhibitions, and events (MICE). Their brand promise is ‘The city is your venue’. Antwerp Convention Bureau highlights the diverse range of conference facilities in Antwerp and builds strong local expertise to support conference organizers and attendees in hosting conferences and business activities within the city.
The goal is to use a comprehensive marketing strategy and a proactive approach to attract international B-2-B events for associations or the industry that generate a positive impact on the residents, entrepreneurs, and visitors of the city of Antwerp. These events reinforce local and regional policies because they are linked to strong economic clusters, knowledge institutions, or centers of expertise.
In order to expand its organization and network, Antwerp Convention Bureau is actively seeking a new Managing Director.

Jobomschrijving

As Managing Director, you are the driving force behind the long-term strategy and financial performance of the organisation. Taking full P&L responsibility, you safeguard the financial health and ensure a maximum return on investment for the allocated budgets. You build on the current momentum by prioritizing the structuring of the organisation, implementing clear processes, and inspiring the internal team. Furthermore, you act as the primary local and international ambassador who proudly carries the bureau's successes to the city and its stakeholders, further shaping its vision within the meeting and convention (MICE) industry. 
As Managing Director, you will be responsible for:

• Managing human and financial resources efficiently within the allocated budgets while meeting the city's KPI’s.
• Coaching, motivating, and guiding the team to perform at their maximum potential, ensuring clear roles and responsibilities.
• Maintaining a strong and proactive network of relationships with the financing government, local stakeholders, and various players within the industry.
• Reporting on operations and milestones to the Executive Board.
• Representing ACB with strong communication skills. Expanding the (inter)national network within the highly competitive meeting industry. Simultaneously, you showcase local successes and act as the public face of the organization fostering the local public relations (PR), translating achievements into pride for the city and local stakeholders. 
• Leading the day-to-day management and further development of the organisation in line with the long-term strategy, ensuring the implementation of clear procedures, best practices, and an optimal organisational structure.

You are first and foremost an organisation builder and a true people manager who provides your team with direction, clarity, and structure. Additionally, you are a business-minded networker who effortlessly represents the organisation and inspires others during presentations and networking events. You possess a strategic approach paired with innovative thinking, and you show great diplomatic sensitivity towards the interests of local stakeholders.
Additionally, you possess:

• A Master’s degree (or equivalent working and thinking level), coupled with substantial experience in setting up, structuring, and leading a solid organisation at a senior management level.
• Strong PR skills and a proven track record of local stakeholder management, successfully communicating results to government, partners, ambassadors, the team and other stakeholders.
• A background in the (inter)national hospitality industry, or experience as a senior business marketing and sales professional within a highly competitive international sector. Experience within the MICE sector is considered a strong asset, though leadership skills are prioritized.
• A strict commitment to being based in Antwerp alongside a readiness to travel internationally.
• Excellent oral and written communication skills in both Dutch and English.

Are you passionate about cutting-edge technology?

Do you thrive on ensuring products meet the highest standards of performance and reliability?

As a Test & Validation Engineer you will be instrumental in validating advanced imaging systems, from prototype to industrialization, ensuring they meet both customer and regulatory standards. You will also mentor junior engineers and drive continuous improvement in our testing processes.

Key Responsibilities:

• Define and implement validation and verification plans for new products and platforms.
• Develop test protocols, acceptance criteria and traceability matrices.
• Conduct hands-on testing of sensors, cameras, and modules, covering electrical, optical, mechanical and environmental aspects.
• Automate test procedures using LabVIEW, Python or similar tools.
• Analyze test results, identify root causes and propose corrective actions.
• Improve test methodologies, tools and infrastructure to support scalable industrialization.
• Collaborate with R&D, project management, quality and operations teams to support design reviews and product improvements.
• Mentor junior engineers and share best practices within the team.

• Master’s degree in Electronics, Physics, Optics, or related engineering field.
• Min. 3-5 years of experience in test engineering, validation, or reliability engineering in a high-tech environment 
• Hands-on experience with test automation (Python expertise needed).
• Familiarity with optical/electro-optical testing is a strong plus.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills; ability to get to root causes.
• Excellent communication skills; capable of writing clear technical documentation and presenting to stakeholders.
• Ability to mentor and guide less experienced engineers.
• Fluent in English; knowledge of Dutch is a plus.

For a client in the Deinze that specializes in making an artisanal food product, we are looking for a motivated packer.

What will you do?

• Packing individual portions, bars, and bags using the machine
• Working according to a clear schedule
• Carrying out your tasks independently and responsibly

Who are you?

• Diplomas or specific experience are not required, your motivation and enthusiasm come first!
• You want to work with a machine
• You are fully ready to roll up your sleeves and help your colleagues where needed
• You enjoy contributing to a pleasant team atmosphere
• Routine work doesn't scare you

Robert Half is currently looking for a PAN-EU Financial Controller (M/F/X) for a company located in the Beringen region.

Our client is an international organization with a well-established European hub in Belgium. The company operates in a fast-moving and structured environment, supporting large-scale operations across multiple countries while maintaining a strong focus on quality, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

The responsibilities for this job as PAN-EU Financial Controller (M/F/X) include:

• You take on a pan-European finance controlling role within an international finance team.
• You support financial reporting and controlling activities in close collaboration with local and international stakeholders.
• You report directly to the Finance Manager and contribute to the follow-up of key finance processes.
• You help ensure accurate analysis, reporting, and financial follow-up in an English-speaking business environment.
• You contribute to month-end closing activities and are prepared to provide extra support during the first working days of the month.
• You work closely with a small finance team in a multicultural and structured setting.

The requested qualifications for this job include:

• You hold a bachelor's degree in accounting, Finance, Taxation, or a related field, or you bring equivalent relevant experience.
• You have 1 to 5 years of experience in Accounting, Finance, Audit, or Controlling.
• You communicate fluently in English, both written and spoken.
• You combine strong analytical skills with the ability to work independently.
• You are comfortable using Microsoft Office in your daily work.
• You are a professional and respectful communicator with a strong work ethic.
• You have a mature, proactive, and hands-on mindset.
• You feel comfortable in a structured environment.
• You bring experience with SAP, IFRS, VAT, corporate tax, budgeting, forecasting, management reporting, or external audits as an advantage.
• You are motivated by working in an international and multicultural environment.

You will work with modern technologies in an innovative and sustainable environment and contribute to the company's success.

Do you want to contribute to cutting‑edge innovation by ensuring flawless contract handling, documentation control, and follow‑up within an international organization?

Your responsibilities:

• Learn & initiate the company's approval flow for a certain type of business contracts/quotations and entities

• Initiate internal & external signature handling (paper - electronic)

To support our further growth ambitions, Brantsandpatents is looking for a 
Patent Advisor or (partially qualified) European Patent Attorney 
with a background in chemistry, preferable organic chemistry.
 

As a Patent Advisor, you will analyze the R&D activities and innovations of your clients and develop an appropriate IP strategy based on this analysis.
 

Within the patent department, you will work with other patent engineers and patent paralegals. In this varied role, you will be responsible for mapping (technical) inventions, drafting patent applications, and managing and guiding the patent portfolios of clients.
 

You will keep an eye on competing innovations and advise on potential conflicts when necessary. You will also proactively propose solutions. You will represent your clients before the Belgian Intellectual Property Office and the European Patent Office.
 

You'll work from our office in Ghent.
 

 

You have or are...
 
 

• A university degree in chemistry, chemical engineering or similar, with a strong preference for organic chemistry. A PhD in chemistry is a strong plus. 

• Strong analytical skills and a results-oriented, quality-driven approach. 

• A client-driven mindset. 

• Fluent in Dutch with a good knowledge of English. 

• Interest in legal principles and patent law. 

• Willingness to invest in training to become a patent attorney.

jobs.occupation: Orderpicker – Rotating Shifts – Become an essential link at SKF!
jobs.description:

SKF is the place where you contribute to keeping the world running smoothly. We are looking for motivated warehouse employees who deliver top‑quality service to our customers.

✔️ You are physically fit and enjoy active work

✔️ Strong comprehension and speaking level of either Dutch or English

jobs.description:

Choosing Capgemini means choosing a company where you will be empowered to shape your career in the way you’d like, where you’ll be supported and inspired by a collaborative community of colleagues around the world, and where you’ll be able to reimagine what’s possible. Join us and help the world’s leading organizations unlock the value of technology and build a more sustainable, more inclusive world

Join the Powerhouse of Innovation at Capgemini's SAP Application Maintenance & Development Department and be part of revolutionizing business operations through optimized SAP systems!

 

YOUR ROLE

As a SAP Service Delivery Manager you will be responsible for all SAP related projects and all SAP related improvement services at the client. You will be responsible for project delivery, service delivery, people management and the client relationship. You will perform a combination of Project Management and Service Delivery Management task

As you will be responsible of ensuring the qualitative delivery of the agreed services to the partner, you will have to make sure your team will be performing as expected and helping them evolve.

• Foster strong interpersonal and team spirit for collaborative delivery.
• Implement structured processes to meet contractual service levels effectively.
• Proactively mitigate risks and detect issues.
• Cultivate good relationship-building skills to enhance cooperation.
• 
Possess strong communication skills for managing stakeholders and daily customer interactions.

 

YOUR PROFILE

• Responsible for overall engagement management including budget, customer satisfaction, contractual compliance, service continuity, team motivation, and timely delivery.
• Minimum 3-5 years of experience in SAP projects or related services.
• Act as the Customer Single Point of Contact for AMS Services topics.
• Provide consolidated management reporting on service performance to both the Customer and Capgemini.
• Play a pivotal role in add-on sales with the Sales & Delivery Management team.
• 
Fluent in Dutch or French with professional working proficiency in English.

Are you technically skilled, detail-oriented, and looking for a varied role in a warm, family-owned company? Then this position as Mould Technician could be the perfect fit for you!

In this role, you will be responsible for the correct assembly and disassembly of moulds. Every changeover is carried out with great attention to detail and in line with established procedures, ensuring that all equipment remains in perfect condition. Careful handling and precision are key.

After a thorough onboarding period and once you have gained sufficient experience, you will also be responsible for restarting machines after a changeover. In addition, you will support the mould department with various tasks such as:

• Maintenance and repair of moulds
• Assembling and fine-tuning moulds
• Providing general technical support
• No two days are the same!

• Strong mechanical knowledge is essential
• Able to work very precisely and neatly
• Experience in a similar technical role is an advantage
• Skilled in setting up production machines and tools
• Able to plan efficiently and set priorities, both independently and in a team
• Methodical approach, following procedures with an eye for improvement
• Quick to analyse, report, and adjust when needed
• Positive, constructive attitude
• Good command of English is required, as one colleague communicates exclusively in English

Pearl Therapy Center is expanding its network of English-speaking psychologists and clinical psychologists to support English-speaking clients across Belgium, both at professional office locations and online.
 

We match each client with the most suitable professional based on their needs, presenting concerns, language, cultural background, personal preferences and the professional’s area of expertise.
 

Your role: to provide individual, couple and/or family psychological consultations and therapy sessions to clients who match your profile and expertise.
 

Face-to-face sessions may take place in professional office locations in cities such as Brussels, Antwerp, Ghent, Leuven, Mechelen, Zaventem, Vilvoorde, Aalst, Hasselt, Genk, Turnhout, Geel, Beringen, Sint-Truiden and other suitable locations in Belgium. Online sessions are also possible where appropriate.
 

The collaboration model is 
flexible and session-based. In consultation with Pearl Therapy Center, you can indicate the days, hours and regions in which you wish to see clients.
 

Basic requirements:
 
 

• Meet the diploma, registration and legal requirements necessary to work as a psychologist in Belgium. 

• For clinical psychologists: meet the required recognition and professional visa requirements. 

• Be able to professionally support English-speaking clients and conduct psychological consultations and therapy sessions in English. 

• Work in accordance with professional ethics, confidentiality and professional boundaries.  

Pearl Therapy Center manages client acquisition, advertising, initial contact, appointment scheduling, payments and general administrative processes. This allows you to focus primarily on 
your clients and your work as a psychologist.

 

• Ability to professionally support English-speaking clients and conduct therapy sessions in English. 

• Meet the diploma, registration and legal requirements to work as a psychologist in Belgium. 

• For clinical psychologists: meet the required recognition and professional visa requirements. 

• Respect professional ethics and confidentiality. 

• Maintain professional boundaries and appropriate communication with clients. 

• Work within your own area of expertise and professional competence. 

• Respect scheduled appointments and agreed working hours. 

• Be open to working with clients from different cultural backgrounds. 

• Be able to work within Pearl Therapy’s multidisciplinary model and client–psychologist matching system. 

• Meet the legal requirements to work and carry out a self-employed activity in Belgium. 

•

jobs.occupation: Extra income as CE truck driver - part-time or weekend work
jobs.description:
Are you living in Belgium and looking for some extra income? Do you have a valid CE driving licence and experience as a CE truck driver, HGV driver or lorry driver? And do you want a flexible way to earn extra money alongside your current job or during your free days?

For a well-established transport company in Oostkamp, specialized in frozen food transport and temperature-controlled logistics, we're looking for reliable CE truck drivers who want to work one or more days per week. You decide when you're available: weekdays, Saturdays, or both. And the best part is that Dutch isn't required; you can also apply if you only speak English!

Your job

As a CE driver, you will deliver frozen food products to supermarkets, distribution centres, and business customers across Belgium and neighbouring countries.

Your drives:

• Transport of frozen goods

• National deliveries throughout Belgium, but also to the Netherlands, Luxembourg, France and Germany

• Up to 15h/day on the road (waiting and resting times included)

• Varying number of stops: between 5 to 15 stops/day

Routes are prepared in advance and your trailer is already loaded, connected, fuelled, and ready to go before departure.

You'll almost never have to sleep in your truck, except for some for very exceptional cases when there's no other possibility.

We're looking for a driver who:

• Has a valid CE driving licence, code 95 and driver card

• Is residing in Belgium and has legal right to work in the country

• Has a good level of English

• Isn't afraid to start early in the morning and to tackle longer routes

• Has their own transport to the company (no public transport nearby)

Previous experience in frozen food transport, refrigerated transport or distribution transport is an advantage but not required.

 

!! IMPORTANT ELIGIBILITY REQUIREMENTS: please read carefully before applying !!

• You must already be living in Belgium

• You must already have a valid legal right to work in Belgium (EU citizenship or valid work permit)

Candidates who do not meet these requirements will not be considered for the position. We do not provide visa sponsorship, work permits, relocation support or immigration assistance.

jobs.occupation: WEEKENDSHIFT Customer Service Officer Dutch-Polish-English – Multilingual Support Champion
jobs.description:
Are you ready to join a vibrant, multicultural team that helps people in need every single day? As a Customer Service Officer, you’ll play a key role in ensuring that drivers with broken-down vehicles or trucks get back on the road quickly and safely. You’ll work closely with your team lead and helpful colleagues, gaining exposure to people from diverse backgrounds and learning new skills all the time.

On a typical day, you’ll handle incoming phone calls and emails, respond to customer inquiries, and coordinate with various parties to ensure efficient solutions. You’ll gather information, verify data accuracy, and provide technical support by communicating with workshops. Keeping customers and all involved parties updated is crucial, as is monitoring agreements and following up on contract-related issues within set deadlines. Your work week runs Monday through Friday, with the flexibility to help out on Saturdays during busy periods, and you’ll rotate shifts between 7:00 AM and 10:00 PM.

If you’re passionate about helping others, thrive in a fast-paced environment, and enjoy using your language skills every day, we want to hear from you! Apply now to join our team and start making a real impact while growing your career.

• Proficiency in Dutch, Polish, and English (spoken and written); additional languages are a plus

• Strong computer skills, especially with Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook)

• Effective telephone communication and interpersonal abilities

• Analytical thinking and problem-solving skills

• Customer- and results-oriented mindset

• High degree of accuracy and attention to detail

• Ability to multitask and stay calm under pressure

• Technical knowledge of automotive or tires is a plus

• No specific previous experience required

• Education at higher secondary, associate, or bachelor’s degree level

• Open to candidates at all career levels: starter, junior, medior, senior, executive

jobs.occupation: Contract Administration Officer (Temporary assignment at 80%) - In Leuven
jobs.description:
As a Contract Administration Officer, you will work in a dynamic, international environment where you manage and follow up on business contracts and quotations. You will quickly learn approval procedures and serve as the point of contact for internal and external communication regarding the signing flow. You process contracts both on paper and electronically and keep administration up-to-date in CRM and SharePoint.

A typical working day involves initiating and tracking approval flows, managing documents, and communicating about the status of files. You ensure smooth internal and external signing procedures, process purchase orders (PO) in CRM according to the applicable guidelines, and follow up accurately. Your organizational skills and sense of ownership make a difference in the smooth running of administrative processes.

Are you ready to join a forward-thinking team where technology and innovation are central? Apply today and use your administrative talents for an assignment that impacts society tomorrow!

• You have at least a secondary education diploma or a professional bachelor's degree
• You have 2 to 5 years of relevant administrative experience
• You work accurately and have an eye for detail
• You can quickly learn and apply complex procedures and guidelines
• You are organizationally strong, can prioritize, and like to take ownership
• You follow up files from A to Z and communicate smoothly with all parties involved
• You have an excellent command of English (both spoken and written) + knowledge of Dutch is a plus
• Experience in an international environment is an asset
• You are communicative, disciplined, and enjoy working in a team
